competence_gaps.competence: Specialized SCM & Planning Systems (SAP APO, Kinaxis RapidResponse, Oracle SCM)
competence_gaps.jd_requirement: Solid knowledge of an ERP system (SAP, APO or Oracle or Kinaxis etc)
competence_gaps.candidate_reality: Candidate has hands-on experience with core SAP user/reporting, Power BI, and Microsoft Power Automate, but has not used dedicated APS/SCM engines like SAP APO or Kinaxis.
competence_gaps.gap_analysis: While the candidate understands data pipelines, reporting layers, and general SAP queries, they lack familiarity with Kinaxis/APO supply-demand balancing heuristics and scheduling algorithms.
competence_gaps.mitigation_strategy: Highlight rapid adaptability in complex data environments, advanced Power BI/Excel modeling, and Python/SQL capabilities to extract and model planning data directly from data lakes and ERP backends.

competence_gaps.competence: Physical Supply Chain & S&OP Domain Experience (Oil & Gas / Lubricants / FMCG)
competence_gaps.jd_requirement: High level understanding of sales and supply chain activities (logistics, demand planning and supply planning processes)
competence_gaps.candidate_reality: 15+ years of capacity planning, deployment logistics, and SLA tracking in telecommunications and enterprise tech; no direct manufacturing or physical lubricant supply chain experience.
competence_gaps.gap_analysis: The candidate has not worked within oil & gas or FMCG distribution networks, inventory stock holding policies, or seasonal SKU replenishment cycles.
competence_gaps.mitigation_strategy: Frame telecom capacity forecasting, equipment rollout logistics, and SLA delivery as direct transferable analogues to supply/demand balancing and logistics performance management.

competence_gaps.competence: SAP Business Objects (BO) / Legacy MI Reporting Suites
competence_gaps.jd_requirement: Solid knowledge of business reporting tools (e.g. MI/SAP Business Objects)
competence_gaps.candidate_reality: Extensive experience with modern BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, Excel/VBA), but no verified exposure to SAP Business Objects / MI.
competence_gaps.gap_analysis: If the team relies on legacy SAP BO universes or MI interfaces, the candidate will require initial orientation on BO report generation.
competence_gaps.mitigation_strategy: Demonstrate that core BI principles, SQL queries, and Power BI/Power Automate expertise enable frictionless transition to any enterprise reporting tool.

strong_points: Proven track record in end-to-end performance analytics, KPI dashboard design (Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python), and automated data pipelines using Power Automate.

Direct experience interfacing with SAP ERP reporting systems and architecting cross-functional business intelligence solutions.
weak_points: Lack of direct physical supply chain experience in oil & gas, lubricants, or FMCG manufacturing and warehouse logistics.
No verified working experience with specialized SCM planning suites (SAP APO, Kinaxis RapidResponse, Oracle SCM), relying instead on custom BI and automated pipeline tooling.
No direct hands-on exposure to SAP Business Objects (BO) / legacy MI reporting environments.
Formal education is in Computer Science and Systems Engineering rather than a business, economics, or formal supply chain degree.
